description: This PHP class 'WordReportRenderer' generates Word document reports from templates, incorporating project data, findings, attachments, and revisions, and saves the report as an attachment.

classes.name: WordReportRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering Word reports from templates, embedding project data, findings, attachments, and revisions, then saving and attaching the generated report.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the renderer with a logger, file path service, and attachment repository, and enables output escaping in settings.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates a Word report based on project, report, template attachment, and variables; saves the report as an attachment and returns its ID.

methods.name: replaceRowWithHtml
methods.description: Replaces a placeholder row in the template with HTML content by converting it into a table structure.
